reason: Five gaps left by #492, #499, #502, #504 and #505. (1) chat._routing_thoughts hid a provider control frame only when the routing text started with one, so commentary followed by an unreadable DSML, GLM or DeepSeek frame beside a real tool call put the raw frame into the operator's reasoning; it now keeps only the text before the first frame anywhere (_operator_answer_text / tool_markup.frame_start). (2) ContextCompactor._request_memory told the model to match 'the supplied schema' but sent it only as response_format, so a provider without structured output never saw it; the schema now goes in the instructions via json_schema_instruction whenever it is not on the wire, and _hierarchical_memory reserves room for it when sizing segments (the two small-window mission compaction tests in test_orchestration.py exercise that reserve). (3) _recover_context_length_rejection rebuilt the retry from the stored transcript only; a non-streamed complete() has no durable turn and stores its messages with the answer, so a brand-new conversation failed with 'could not be reassembled safely' and an existing one was retried without the operator's current message; recovery now appends the unstored new messages (with selected context). (4) The mission specialist loop replayed each earlier call as its own assistant message with no reasoning; agent_tooling now tags each routing response's records with response_group, reasoning_state (first record) and provider_metadata and _provider_tool_history passes them on, so #502's adapters replay one message per batch with its reasoning; a deviation-blocked result drops those fields. (5) The Settings provider dialog's 'Maximum output tokens' placeholder said '2048 default', wrong since #492; it now says the value is sized from the model with a help note. tests/v3/test_chat_leftovers.py (11 tests, 9 fail on origin/main 710b785; the 2 guards pass before and after) drives each path; the other node ids are the edited test_context assertion and the closest existing tests of the changed functions. SettingsPage.test.tsx gains a test that fails on main.
exclusions: No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. Playwright: only entry:workbench-view-authority/desktop, the narrowest catalogued entry whose tests open the Add model provider dialog ('stabilization audit every primary workspace view'); no screenshot baseline shows the collapsed Advanced provider options, so no baseline changes. Frontend: only SettingsPage.test.tsx, the component's own vitest file. Python: whole large files (test_chat.py, test_chat_tool_loop.py, test_orchestration.py, test_context.py and others) ran locally and are excluded; only the node ids listed are selected. No full suites.
